description:
## Finding

Redundant `.clone()` at `pkix-path/src/lib.rs:3547`:

```
3547:            rsa.tbs_certificate.subject_public_key_info.clone(),
```

Inside a test that constructs a `TrustAnchor` from values that are not used afterwards. Clippy: `-W clippy::redundant_clone`.

## Fix

Remove the `.clone()`.

## Priority

P4 — test code, no correctness impact.
title: P4: redundant clone in pkix-path/src/lib.rs:3547 (test code)
